title: Andy Cooks' Creamy French Tarragon Chicken (Poulet à l'Estragon)
ingredients: 4 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs or boneless chicken breasts
1 tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp unsalted butter
1/2 cup dry white wine (Sauvignon Blanc or Chardonnay)
1/2 cup heavy cream or crème fraîche
1 large bunch fresh tarragon, leaves picked and roughly chopped
Juice of 1/2 lemon, kosher salt, and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Season chicken generously with salt and pepper. Sear skin-side down in a heavy skillet with olive oil over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until golden crisp, flip for 3 minutes, and remove to a plate.
Add butter to the pan and sweat the finely diced shallots and garlic with a few tarragon stems over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Pour in the white wine to deglaze, scraping up the golden chicken fond, and reduce by half.
Add chicken stock and Dijon mustard, return the chicken to the pan, and simmer for 10–12 minutes until cooked through. Stir in cream, fresh chopped tarragon leaves, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
